claims.claim: Prospective admission authenticates the original active RUN and exact policy, Human sources, operation, profile and lease. Advertised competing selectors and hidden packed/loose conflicts reject.

RUN-scoped limits retain defaults of 2 corrections, 3 checkpoints, 240 wall minutes, 180 verification minutes within wall, and null tokens. Invalid, overlapping or inapplicable overrides reject; unknown cumulative usage blocks finite token caps.
Original protected admission freezes effective limits, source/version, override provenance, operation, execution profile and fresh per-RUN consent, with later currentness checks.

Original Runtime fencing retains monotone reservations, spent counters, cumulative costs and crash/replay accounting. Withdrawal, lost continuity, drift, exhaustion, uncertainty and terminal state latch STOP.

PRIMARY, REPAIR and REMEDIATION retain independent source checks. REMEDIATION hashing now supports immutable acceptance maps. Versioned controlled admission keeps unsupported correction continuity BLOCKED and production NOT_ACTIVATED.
Unopted execution and direct native APIs retain existing codec, callback identity and source guards. Published Git decision-guard and unresolved-FAILURE handoff paths remain intact.

Real-Git/native regressions cover consent, overrides, thresholds, replay, withdrawal, crash and concurrency. Reviewed manifests now bind the execution phase, correction fixtures declare the required policy, and existing guard/handoff regressions remain unchanged.

The clean committed repair contains only three permitted files atop the exact failed candidate, preserving original lineage and TASK scope without adding authority, production activation or roadmap advancement.
